classification: Validation, EXPLORATORY diagnostics at RS-S003 scales, then registered fresh-scale comparisons

identity_audit.conjugation: (conj a / conj p)_n = conj((a/p)_n) for n = 3, 4, 6 (Galois equivariance of the residue symbol; conj sends zeta6 = 1+w to zeta6^-1). Primary primes map to primary primes of the same norm.
identity_audit.reciprocity: E[j][i] = E[i][j] + S[i][j]*(n/2), with S the exact pairwise mask (zero for n = 3; parity form for n = 4; mod-4 class function for n = 6, not parity form).
identity_audit.mask_conjugation_invariance: S[c(i)][c(j)] = S[i][j] (follows from the two identities; checked exactly).
identity_audit.conjugate_pairs: x = (pi / conj pi)_n satisfies x = s * conj(x), s = S-sign: x = 1 (n = 3); x in {+-1} or {+-i} by p mod 8 (n = 4); s = +1 and x in {+-1} (n = 6). Copied into the control.
identity_audit.cubic_hermitian: n = 3: C symmetric and C[c,c] = conj(C) imply H = C P Hermitian (H_ij = C_{i,c(j)}), commuting with the antiunitary P K, so H is real symmetric in a real basis; singular values of C = |eigenvalues| of H. The forced diagonal H_ii = 1.
identity_audit.orbit_group: The index-pair maps generated by transpose and conjugation form Z2 x Z2; conjugation is the only nontrivial Galois automorphism of Q(w) and Q(i), and units do not act on the primary index set. No other identity was found; completeness of all algebraic relations is not claimed.
identity_audit.quadratic: n = 2 has rational indices and no conjugation; its RS-S002 null is unchanged.

control_definition: native rs_random_conj: SplitMix64 counter draw (as rs_random) of the smallest ordered representative (a<b) of each {transpose, conjugation} orbit; transposes get the exact mask shift; conjugate images get -k; (i, c(i)) copied; diagonal 255.
